message.content: {"rules":["The `len` bytes starting at `ptr` must be valid UTF-8.","`ptr` must be non-null, including when `len` is zero.","`ptr` must be properly aligned for `u8`, including when `len` is zero.","`ptr` must be valid for reads of `len` bytes.","`ptr` must be valid for writes of `len` bytes.","The entire `len`-byte memory range must be contained within a single allocated object; it must not span multiple allocated objects.","`ptr` must point to `len` consecutive properly initialized `u8` values.","For the duration of the returned mutable string's lifetime `'a`, its referenced memory must not be read through any pointer not derived from the return value.","For the duration of the returned mutable string's lifetime `'a`, its referenced memory must not be written through any pointer not derived from the return value.","The total size, `len` bytes, must be no larger than `isize::MAX`.","Adding `len` bytes to `ptr` must not wrap around the address space.","When `len` is zero, a pointer obtained using `NonNull::dangling()` may be used as `ptr`."]}
